title: Choose the visual world for the new supperFastShop
question: The roll assigned The Hang Tag. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Hang Tag
options.lineage: garment swing tags, woven care labels and retail price guns
options.thesis: Every screen is a tag on the garment: price-gun stickers, woven labels, barcodes and size runs do the talking, not photos.
options.viewport: A drenched safety-orange field; one oversized die-cut tag with a punched hole hangs in it, carrying the name, a live size run (XS-XL as stamped cells) and a SHOP NOW sticker; search sits on the string.
options.risk: Becomes a costume if the tags are decoration instead of the actual cards, filters and cart rows.

raised.raise: Total spot-ink commitment: only orange, black, white and one acid-yellow sticker ink, with stickers printed a hair off register.
Unlit is designed too: sold-out sizes and empty states are drawn as ghost cells, never removed.

options.label: Drop Day Shoebox
options.lineage: sneaker release boxes and raffle tickets
options.thesis: Every product is a numbered release in a box: label sticker, size grid, a drop countdown.
options.viewport: A box lid with a huge numbered release label, size grid and a Cop button.
options.risk: Also where most streetwear shops land, so it can read as familiar.

options.label: Risograph Zine
options.thesis: Two fluorescent inks misregister on toothy paper.
options.viewport: Cut-paper shapes in fluoro pink and blue, ink layers just off register.
options.case: Strong audience fit and zine energy; weaker on clarity for prices and checkout.
options.risk: Paper ground leans cream-and-print, which is a known default look.

options.label: Mondo Duotone
options.thesis: Two impossible inks print everything, headlines slammed at an angle.
options.viewport: Angled headline slab over a duotone grid with a glossary-style margin nav.
options.case: Loud and youthful; navigation by glossary costs clarity on a shop.
options.risk: Duotone on product imagery can hide real colors.

options.label: Seven-Segment Totem
options.case: Loses both: reads as electronics, not clothes.

options.label: Akari Workshop
options.case: Loses both: calm craft is the wrong energy for fast streetwear.

options.label: Brick Instructions
options.case: Loses both: toy-assembly metaphor does not fit apparel.

options.label: Chaekgeori Shelves
options.case: Loses both: heritage painting, wrong audience.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean product-grid store, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Hero banner, category row, product grid.
